dissent: validation-contract.json still names same-model Astra reviews while model-revision-01 supersedes to gpt-5.6-sol xhigh; the proposal records Sol as governing new reviews, but a literal reading of the contract could dispute that succession.

The conservative all-Windows classification may over-assign ownership: some of the 87 commands could in fact be host-neutral, but with the authoritative list absent the design refuses per-command portability claims rather than guess.

The manifest/receipt required-key lists are a minimal binding contract, not the historical Windows receipt schema, which is not in tracked evidence; an owner of the original gate could find them insufficient.
One could argue the manifest should embed concrete command rows now; doing so would fabricate absent data, so the design instead marks them UNRESOLVED pending a sha256-bound authoritative source.
findings: Obligation inventory: two complete uninterrupted exact-candidate gates of 87 commands each including all 50 Batch07 commands, plus two owned receipt/source audits and two independent same-model (now gpt-5.6-sol xhigh) final reviews; infrastructure/checkpoint gates are not scientific acceptance.
Portability is BLOCKED by policy: unchanged Windows receipt-path and host-identity checks cannot pass truthfully on Linux, and native local checks must not be called the full87 gate.

Intrinsically Windows-bound predicate families: receipt-path assertions, host-identity binding, the qualified Windows Ruff lint route (Ruff is not installed natively; checkpoint-gate-01 FAILed on it), and the Windows-measured timing envelope.

WSL-duplicable supplemental checks: the complete unit suite (70 tests/1 skip on WSL vs 7 skips on Windows, so coverage differs), source py_compile, diff-check/cleanliness/ancestry, and the native admission-reservation-run-audit chain emitting PASS_LOCAL_RESEARCH_ONLY with full_gate_equivalence=false; none can satisfy the gate.

Windows-owned receipt identities: both gate receipts, all 87 per-command receipts (incl. 50 Batch07), the windows-ruff receipt, any host/path-asserting receipt, the 'full87' label, and the 655520 inherited-full-gate-pair ledger row.

The packet contains no per-command argv/cwd/env/timeout for the 87 commands and no authoritative command manifest; the deliverable's manifest therefore binds an external command_source by sha256 with entries_status UNRESOLVED_PENDING_AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE and ready=false.

Two-host design: windows-primary owns inherited commands with native Windows path/host capture; wsl-native owns supplemental and successor-added checks; cross-host witnessing copies Windows receipts read-only via /mnt/c and records alias versus native path separately without rewriting either.

Successor-gate composition encoded per the validation contract: Windows-owned 87-command pair plus native added checker/controls/retained-audit receipts under one candidate+manifest sha256, then owned audits and dual Sol xhigh final reviews.
limitations: Source-only construction: nothing was imported, executed, or admitted; no scientific acceptance, execution, or gate equivalence is claimed.
The 87-command list, Batch07 subset identity, authoritative manifest location, Windows-side runner, and host-identity capture mechanism are all absent from tracked evidence and remain unresolved.

Windows host availability and synchronization of the Windows worktree to the final candidate are outside native control; the native workspace itself is still a dirty dc6e8d0 integration tree and the publication candidate is moving.
/mnt/c provides observation, not execution or Windows path identity; witness records cannot convert a native run into a Windows gate.
Deadline pressure is unresolved: two ~4800s gate admissions plus 600s finalization must fit the 10200s reserve inside the immutable 2026-09-11T23:51:42Z deadline.

Unresolved accounting and unreachable-witness items are preserved: control-to-global-ledger mapping is unadmitted, the all-additive control estimate exceeds the 5000000 ceiling, and unavailable retained-control witnesses would force INCOMPLETE_FIXED_CONTROL_SUITE.
summary: Wrote docs/v3/construction/swarm-research-20260911-155142/wave07/proposals/windows-gate-portability.json: a source-only design that inventories the inherited 87-command Windows gate obligations from tracked evidence (two complete exact-candidate gates, all 50 Batch07 commands, 4800s/gate admission from measured 3771.077387s/3576.111586s, 655520-unit pair reserve counted once), classifies predicates into intrinsically Windows/path-bound versus WSL-duplicable supplemental versus Windows-owned receipt identities, and defines an executable two-host manifest plus hash-bound receipt/witness design that never fakes paths, host identity, or unrun PASS. Absent per-command details are recorded as UNRESOLVED, not invented.
